summary.text: Greg Oblander is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 38 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A chiropractor and clinic owner, he is vice chair of the House Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Greg Oblander was born in and lives in Yellowstone County, Montana, and earned a doctorate in chiropractic from Logan University.
His career experience includes working as an ATV instructor, in the oil and gas division of Montana Power, and as a chiropractor and owner of two chiropractic clinics.
He served as vice president of the Montana Trail Vehicle Riders Association and as president of the Montana Petroleum Landman Association.
Oblander won the House general election in 2022, representing District 40, and was re-elected in District 38 on November 5, 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the House Natural Resources Committee and is assigned to the Agriculture and Business and Labor committees.
